answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 156 Country: India Title: Is It Permissible to Market Handicrafts with Carvings of Animate Objects? Question: We are running an org. where we are providing marketting facility to artisans dealing in handicrafts sector. the artisans carve animate objects on the handicrafts items. Now my question is that can we provide marketting facilities to these items which are in demand in foreign countries? Answer ID: 156 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 126=128/L) How do you provide marketing facilities? Please, explain it and send the question again. However, getting pictures of living being carved by someone is also forbidden as making picture it by yourself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
